statement: Regulatory Approval Status: Regulatory Status Unknown

Summary: SkinVision is a health technology company focused on increasing access to skin health awareness and care. It supports individuals in becoming more aware of their skin over time, helping them take a more active role in their health journey. The service is currently not available in the United States, pending regulatory clearance.
Medical Purpose: To increase access to skin health awareness and care, and to support individuals in becoming more aware of their skin over time.
Role in Decision-Making: To help individuals take a more active role in their skin health journey by increasing awareness and accessibility to information.
Intended Users: Individuals seeking to increase their awareness and understanding of their skin health.
Model Development & Validation: The company collaborates with medical experts, researchers, and leading institutions, including Mayo Clinic, for ongoing research and development in digital health.
